tasks.title: Add rules-only MVPStyli AGENTS.md
tasks.goal: Create one short root AGENTS.md with merge/approval/no-archive rules and a direct link to the current studio exec.md; no vision narrative.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/agentsRules.test.cjs verifies one root AGENTS.md, canonical exec.md link, no duplicate vision or archive reads, and rules-only format.

tasks.title: Enforce current vision version in PR CI
tasks.goal: Require each MVPStyli coding PR body to declare Vision version: vN, matching the current studio exec.md on main; missing, old and unknown versions fail.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/visionVersion.test.cjs tests matching/missing/stale PR-body versions using a mocked canonical source; workflow runs checker on pull_request and fails a mismatch against current studio main.

tasks.title: Map Shop, garments and routes
tasks.goal: Record every Shop reader, catalog endpoint and cross-route dependency before removing UI.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/shopMap.test.cjs checks documented routes, product-detail links, garment and size dependencies against source.

tasks.title: Stylist screen shell
tasks.goal: Replace Shop tab with a visual shell, current outfit, cards, chips and pinned growing chat bar; all local/mock. Gate: PR #4 must merge before editing App.js; otherwise avoid App.js and all PR #4 files.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/shell.test.cjs checks Agent tab route and chat bar states without a network call.
CI: PR #4 status guard confirms merged before any App.js diff; if PR #4 is open, fail when this PR changes App.js or any PR #4-owned file.

external_dependencies.fallback: if not merged, must avoid App.js and every file touched by PR #4; no merge into main until conflicts are safely resolved

tasks.title: Apply verified design system
tasks.goal: Match owner mockup and Thanmayi profile/wardrobe/themes wireframes; retain existing actions.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/design.test.cjs checks token use and accessible labels; snapshot check of reference layout.

tasks.title: Chat intents and catalog sheet
tasks.goal: Reuse style signals and SerpAPI/garment search; show ~10 cards in same-screen sheet.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/chatCatalog.test.cjs mocks catalog and search failure, verifies 10-card cap and closed/open sheet.

tasks.title: Elevate via PR #4 try-on
tasks.goal: Wire Try On cards to PR #4 gated API and image replacement; no new model client. Gate: PR #4 must merge before editing App.js; otherwise avoid App.js and all PR #4 files.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/tryOnAdapter.test.cjs mocks PR4, asserts no client history writes and image remains on failure.
CI: PR #4 status guard confirms merged before any App.js diff; if PR #4 is open, fail when this PR changes App.js or any PR #4-owned file.

external_dependencies.fallback: if not merged, must avoid App.js and every file touched by PR #4; no merge into main until conflicts are safely resolved

tasks.title: Suggest and start Pod
tasks.goal: Use style intelligence to suggest a global/friends/twins Pod; create only after confirmation.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/podConsent.test.cjs asserts no Pod insert before Yes and checks cancel/retry.

tasks.title: Closet and three looks
tasks.goal: Stylist Style my closet: require 3–4 clothing photos and an existing full-body profile photo; generate immediately (not More Looks). Server GPT-4.1 mini plans Closet-only, Elevated (+1–2 catalog pieces) and new-style Makeover; server composes each outfit and sends three parallel PR #4 try-ons. Ask optional question, show 3 swipe cards and individual Retry/Send to Pod.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/threeLooks.test.cjs verifies 3–4 photos, required full-body profile image, immediate start (no More Looks action), optional question saved to profile, parallel 3 PR4 requests, and separate server composition of one garment image per look.

CI: mock LLM planner verifies Closet uses only uploads, Elevated uses at most two catalog pieces, Makeover avoids previously recorded styles; tests verify partial success, failed-card Retry, swipe-card promotion and Send to Pod.
CI: RLS/storage policy tests reject cross-user closet_items reads/writes; no client try_on_history writes; test-only gate prevents live image calls.
CI: PR #4 must report merged before this task branches/merges; assert STYLIT_TRYON_TEST_ENABLED gate is enforced.

external_dependencies.require: merged and based on top of PR #4 before implementation; do not edit its files

tasks.feature_gate: STYLIT_TRYON_TEST_ENABLED; no production/live generation before owner go-live approval

tasks.title: Tomorrow look scheduled preview
tasks.goal: Build opt-in and test-only Vercel/Supabase cron-to-Expo pipeline with calendar/weather stubs, no live sends.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/tomorrow.test.cjs verifies consent, timezone, dedupe, no-permission fallback and zero live pushes.

tasks.title: Fit-aware find and buy
tasks.goal: Offer size only when Fit Profile and chart support it; open verified merchant link, not checkout.
acceptance: CI: node tests/stylist/findBuy.test.cjs tests missing fit/links and asserts only external URL opening, no purchase API.
